content.core_insight: DESIGN.md 正式发布为开放标准，用于在任何项目中捕获设计意图和 Token 值，期望各种 AI 编程助手（如 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等）能够跟进支持。

details.original_tweet: DESIGN.md is now an open specification. A shared format to capture design intent and token values in any project. We've started with a baseline that leaves plenty of room for extension and your own creativity.

action_items: 关注并了解 DESIGN.md 规范及在项目中的潜在应用
查看 GitHub 仓库 google-labs-code/design.md
